claude_proposed_widenings.name: vehicle_or_controlled_object_mechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's main behavior is not a passive grant or a one-shot activation. It creates a persistent controllable object with its own object stats, occupancy, sealed-compartment state, movement modes, and lever-operated commands that change later behavior.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The Apparatus of the Crab is a Large object with the following statistics: AC 20; HP 200; Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. ... A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: lever_state_and_command_table
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The lever table is durable item-owned state. Individual controls toggle shutters, claws, locomotion availability, lighting, hatch state, and attack modes. Those are not expressible as a flat grants list or a single activation phase sequence.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Ten levers are set in a row ... After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position. Each lever, from left to right, functions as shown in the Apparatus of the Crab Levers table.
